about: What each question Claude asks is about, in data-engineering terms: a topic (the kind of concern) and a layer (where in the data stack it sits). Rules are regular expressions tried in order, first on the question's header (the agent's own short label, usually the most precise signal), then on the question text; the first topic and the first layer that match win. A question neither matches falls back to its interview topic (`fallback`: interview topic -> [topic, layer]). Edit freely; see src/session_analytics/semantics.py.
